chain.title: Worn Notebook
chain.desc: Keep the Worn Notebook at your workbench. It contains the diagrams, glyph costs and ritual instructions that turn a collection of machines into a working magic workshop.

chain.title: Novice Spell Book
chain.desc: Open your first spell book and assemble a simple spell from its available glyphs. Test its range and mana cost before adding more effects; this book begins the spellcasting branch independently of your Source workshop.

chain.title: Imbuement Chamber
chain.desc: Place lapis or amethyst into the chamber to begin making Source Gems. It can gather the Source it needs passively; nearby Source Jars accelerate the process, so you do not need a running Sourcelink to begin.

chain.title: Source Jar
chain.desc: Place a Source Jar near the machines you plan to power. Watch its stored Source while a machine works so you can tell whether production is keeping up with demand.

chain.title: Scribe's Table
chain.desc: Use the Scribe's Table to learn additional glyphs. Bring the experience and ingredients shown for the glyph, then add the learned effect to a spell you can already cast.

chain.title: Source Gem
chain.desc: Finish a Source Gem infusion in the Imbuement Chamber. Keep a reserve for pedestals, the Arcane Core and Sourcelinks instead of spending the first batch on decoration.

chain.title: Agronomic Sourcelink
chain.desc: Build a growing area around the Agronomic Sourcelink and put Source Jars nearby. Natural crop and tree growth produces Source; bonemeal growth does not count for this Sourcelink.

chain.title: Arcane Pedestal
chain.desc: Prepare pedestals for the ingredients around an Enchanting Apparatus. Leave room to walk around the arrangement so you can check each ingredient before activating a recipe.

chain.title: Arcane Core
chain.desc: Place the Arcane Core directly below the Enchanting Apparatus. The core and surrounding pedestals form the crafting station used by several branches of your workshop.

chain.title: Enchanting Apparatus
chain.desc: Set the apparatus on its Arcane Core and arrange Arcane Pedestals around it. Put the recipe ingredients on the pedestals, then use the central reagent; some recipes also require stored Source.

chain.title: Ritual Brazier
chain.desc: Set aside an open ritual area and place the brazier. Ritual tablets and their augments determine what happens here, so inspect the Notebook entry before starting a ritual near your base.

chain.title: Magebloom Seed
chain.desc: Use the apparatus to make a Magebloom Seed, then establish a small crop plot. Harvested Magebloom becomes the fibre for mage armour and later armour customisation.

chain.title: Dominion Wand
chain.desc: Use the Dominion Wand to assign connections for your magical helpers. Start with a simple source inventory and destination inventory, then confirm the helper follows the intended route.

chain.title: Apprentice Spell Book
chain.desc: Upgrade the Novice Spell Book with the Enchanting Apparatus. The new tier opens stronger glyphs; revise a familiar spell first so you can see what the upgrade changes.

chain.title: Ritual of Summon Wilden
chain.desc: Prepare the Summon Wilden tablet and the listed Wilden augments. The augmented ritual summons the Wilden Chimera; use an arena with room to move and take healing supplies.

chain.title: Ritual of Flight
chain.desc: Run the Flight ritual where you want a permanent working area and keep its Source supply replenished. Its benefit is local to the ritual, so test the boundary before using it for high construction.

chain.title: Magebloom Fiber
chain.desc: Craft a harvested Magebloom flower into fiber; the textile every piece of mage armor is made from.

chain.title: Starbuncle Charm
chain.desc: Obtain a Starbuncle Token from a wild Starbuncle and use the apparatus recipe to turn it into a charm. Summon the helper and use the Dominion Wand to give it a useful item-transport job.

chain.title: Wilden Chimera
chain.desc: Defeat the Wilden Chimera summoned by the augmented Wilden ritual. Keep moving through its attacks and retrieve the Wilden Tribute after the fight.

chain.title: Sorceror's Wrap
chain.desc: Use the apparatus to make your first mage robe. Wear it while testing spells and compare its mana benefits; this equipment branch can grow alongside book upgrades and familiar automation.

chain.title: Wilden Tribute
chain.desc: Dropped by the Wilden Chimera; the gating ingredient for the final spell book upgrade.
chain.acquisition: Defeat the Wilden Chimera; its entity drop method creates a Wilden Tribute item.

chain.title: Alteration Table
chain.desc: Build the Alteration Table and inspect the thread slots on your mage armour. Choose threads for the way you actually cast rather than filling slots without a plan.

chain.title: Archmage Spell Book
chain.desc: Bring the Apprentice Spell Book and Wilden Tribute to the apparatus with the remaining upgrade ingredients. This final book tier unlocks Tier 3 glyphs and gives your earlier spell experiments much more room to grow.

notes: Reviewed against the primary sources listed above. Every chain row now declares its intended prerequisites; an empty list is an intentional independent starting point. The order is topological. Item and checkpoint-icon asset paths and typed objective identifiers were checked against the listed jar or source snapshot. Jar inspection verifies identifiers and selected mechanics, not that every route has been completed in game.

sources.scope: English guide/tooltip text, recipe data and inventory assets; selected special mechanics checked against implementation.

coverage.scope: Spellcasting, renewable Source, apparatus crafting, mage equipment, helpers and the Wilden-to-Archmage route.
coverage.limits: A curated teaching route, not every item or mechanic. Recipe quantities and conditions follow the installed pack. Manual checkpoints require player confirmation. No complete in-game playthrough claimed.
